name: boss-5-t
about: The title's containment hall: a lighter build of boss-5 (the same source, rig and clips), for a boss seen at the middle distance in its stasis pod. Boss Rush: Group Golem (a slab golem built of filing cabinets). Tripo H3.1 from concept boss05-golem-sd-1; rigged by Tripo (rig v1.0, biped); eight clips retargeted from Tripo's presets (two requests)
bar: the game's one quality bar (2026-11-17): a figure seen at middle distance (the title's pods): 1024 px colour, 512 px other maps, about 20K triangles
